```{r packages}
library(spatstat.geom)
library(spatstat.linnet)
library(knitr)


x_sub_path <- "0313Fri/CM_data/X_sub.rds"

out_dir <- "PU/results"

dir.create(out_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
```

```{r load-data}
X_sub <- readRDS(x_sub_path)

L <- domain(X_sub[[1]])

xy_all <- data.frame()
for (i in seq_len(length(X_sub))) {
  xy_i <- as.data.frame(X_sub[[i]])[, c("x", "y")]
  xy_i$severity <- i
  xy_all <- rbind(xy_all, xy_i)
}

X <- as.lpp(
  x = xy_all$x,
  y = xy_all$y,
  L = L
)
marks(X) <- data.frame(severity = xy_all$severity)

npoints(X)
nsegments(L)
round(volume(L), 2)
```

```{r build-segment-data}
road_lines <- as.psp(L)

segment_id_at_events <- as.data.frame(X)$seg
accident_count <- tabulate(segment_id_at_events, nbins = nsegments(L))

segment_length <- lengths_psp(road_lines)
vertex_degree <- vertexdegree(L)

S <- as.integer(accident_count > 0)
degree_from <- vertex_degree[L$from]
degree_to <- vertex_degree[L$to]

seg <- data.frame(
  seg_id = seq_len(nsegments(L)),
  S = S,
  label = ifelse(S == 1, "P", "U"),
  length_m = segment_length,
  log_length = log1p(segment_length),
  degree_mean = (degree_from + degree_to) / 2,
  dangling = as.integer(degree_from == 1 | degree_to == 1)
)

```

```{r pu-counts}
label_values <- sort(unique(seg$label))
pu_count <- data.frame(
  label = label_values,
  n_segments = NA_integer_,
  total_length_m = NA_real_,
  mean_length_m = NA_real_
)

for (i in seq_along(label_values)) {
  keep <- seg$label == label_values[i]
  pu_count$n_segments[i] <- sum(keep)
  pu_count$total_length_m[i] <- sum(seg$length_m[keep])
  pu_count$mean_length_m[i] <- mean(seg$length_m[keep])
}

pu_count
```

```{r fit two-step-pu}
pu_formula <- S ~ log_length + degree_mean + dangling

naive_fit <- glm(
  pu_formula,
  data = seg,
  family = binomial()
)

seg$naive_score <- predict(naive_fit, newdata = seg, type = "response")

u_rows <- which(seg$S == 0)
rn_cut <- quantile(seg$naive_score[u_rows], probs = 0.1, na.rm = TRUE)

seg$reliable_negative <- seg$S == 0 & seg$naive_score <= rn_cut

train_rows <- seg$S == 1 | seg$reliable_negative

pu_fit <- glm(
  pu_formula,
  data = seg[train_rows, ],
  family = binomial()
)

seg$pu_score <- predict(pu_fit, newdata = seg, type = "response")
seg$pi_support <- ifelse(seg$S == 1, 1, 
                         pmax(seg$pu_score,
                              min(seg$pu_score[seg$pu_score > 0], na.rm = TRUE)))

cat("Reliable negative cut:", round(rn_cut, 4), "\n")
cat("Number of reliable negatives:", sum(seg$reliable_negative), "\n")
cat("Number of training rows:", sum(train_rows), "\n")

```

```{r model-coefficients}
coef_table <- data.frame(
  term = names(coef(pu_fit)),
  estimate = as.numeric(coef(pu_fit))
)
coef_table

```

```{r score-summary, include=FALSE}
label_values <- sort(unique(seg$label))
score_summary <- data.frame(
  label = label_values,
  n = NA_integer_,
  mean_pi = NA_real_,
  q10_pi = NA_real_,
  q50_pi = NA_real_,
  q90_pi = NA_real_
)

for (i in seq_along(label_values)) {
  keep <- seg$label == label_values[i]
  pi_i <- seg$pi_support[keep]
  score_summary$n[i] <- sum(keep)
  score_summary$mean_pi[i] <- mean(pi_i)
  score_summary$q10_pi[i] <- quantile(pi_i, 0.10)
  score_summary$q50_pi[i] <- quantile(pi_i, 0.50)
  score_summary$q90_pi[i] <- quantile(pi_i, 0.90)
}

score_summary
```

```{r intensity}
if (!exists("X_sub")) {
  X_sub <- readRDS("0313Fri/CM_data/X_sub.rds")
}

severity_labs <- c("Severity 1(Lower)", "Severity 2", "Severity 3(Higher)")
severity_cols <- c("red", "blue", "green")
#severity_cols <- c("#E69F00", "#0072B2", "#CC79A7")

sigma_m <- 250

lambda_sub <- vector("list", length(X_sub))
for (i in seq_along(X_sub)) {
  lambda_sub[[i]] <- density(
    X_sub[[i]],
    sigma = sigma_m,
    distance = "path",
    continuous = TRUE,
    kernel = "gaussian",
    finespacing = FALSE,
    verbose = FALSE
  )
}

#pdf("test.pdf",width=15, height=10)
op <- par(mfrow = c(3, 2), mar = c(0.5, 0.5, 2, 0.5))

for (i in seq_along(lambda_sub)) {
  plot(
    lambda_sub[[i]],
    
    main = paste0(severity_labs[i], ": kernel intensity, sigma = ", sigma_m, "m")
  )
  plot(
    lambda_sub[[i]],
    add = FALSE, 
    style = "w",
    main = paste0(severity_labs[i], ": kernel intensity, sigma = ", sigma_m, "m")
  )
  plot(
    as.ppp(X_sub[[i]]),
    add = TRUE,
    cols = severity_cols[i],
    pch = 16,
    cex = 0.3
  )
}

############### PU-CUTOFF ##############

cutoff <- quantile(seg$pi_support, 0.5)
keep_seg <- which(seg$pi_support >= cutoff)
L_sub <- thinNetwork(
  L,
  retainedges = keep_seg
)


df <- as.data.frame(X_sub[[i]])

X_sub_new <- vector("list", length(X_sub))

for (i in seq_along(X_sub)) {
  X_sub_new[[i]] <- thinNetwork(
    X_sub[[i]],
    retainedges = keep_seg
  )
}

lambda_sub_new <- vector("list", length(X_sub_new))
for (i in seq_along(X_sub_new)) {
  lambda_sub_new[[i]] <- density(
    X_sub_new[[i]],
    sigma = sigma_m,
    distance = "path",
    continuous = TRUE,
    kernel = "gaussian",
    finespacing = FALSE,
    verbose = FALSE
  )
}

for (i in seq_along(lambda_sub_new)) {
  plot(
    lambda_sub_new[[i]],
    
    main = paste0(severity_labs[i], ":Sub kernel intensity, sigma = ", sigma_m, "m")
  )
  plot(
    lambda_sub_new[[i]],
    add = FALSE, 
    style = "w",
    main = paste0(severity_labs[i], ":Sub kernel intensity, sigma = ", sigma_m, "m")
  )
  plot(
    as.ppp(X_sub_new[[i]]),
    add = TRUE,
    cols = severity_cols[i],
    pch = 16,
    cex = 0.3
  )
}


par(op)
```
